items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Chick died and I took Ella's band over there, and Dizzy was in that band.

ctx.x: See, Dizzy didn't come into Cab's band until way later. In fact, when I took Ella's band -- Chick died and I took Ella's band over there, and Dizzy was in that band.
Oh, RIGHT. What was he like then?
